name: Daphne Leclair
title: Spellsinger / Skaldic Virtuoso
role: Vocal Attack Buffs, Sonic Stuns & Skaldic Battle Anthems
recruitment_location: The Rusty Flagon Speakeasy (Easton Riverfront Node, X:22, Y:55)

recruitment_requirements.description: Pay off her 350 Col tavern tab OR perform a collaborative battle ballad (CHA DC 14).

bio: A half-elf siren-kin jazz singer whose vocal harmonies bend sound waves into sonic concussions and battle-buffs.

Streetwise Performance.description: Extracting rumors and winning tavern crowds.

abilities: Song of Sovereign Might (+4 DMG & +2 ATK to Party)
Lullaby of the Void (Puts non-elite target to sleep)

berserker_hymn.name: Hymn of the Berserker
berserker_hymn.label: 🎶 Berserker Hymn
berserker_hymn.tactical_effect: Sings a thunderous battle chant; grants Banki +3 Attack rolls and +1d8 weapon damage.

discordant_screech.name: Discordant Screech
discordant_screech.label: 🔊 Discordant Screech
discordant_screech.tactical_effect: Plucks a shattering resonant chord dealing 2d6 Thunder DMG and forcing DC 14 CON check vs Disoriented.

fleeting_shadows.name: Song of Fleeting Shadows
fleeting_shadows.label: 🌫️ Fleeting Shadows
fleeting_shadows.tactical_effect: Weaves acoustic dampening; grants all allies +4 Stealth and +2 Dodge AC.

behavior_prompt: You are Daphne Leclair, a Spellsinger and charismatic skald. You speak with sultry theatrical flair and witty banter. You weave vocal harmonies that supercharge Aria Valkyrie's fury, stagger enemy spellcasters, and slip into enemy blind spots.

inventory.name: Resonating Aether-Lute
inventory.desc: Daphne's masterwork acoustic-arcane lute fitted with a reinforced mithril neck that projects sonic shockwaves and inspiring battle-hymns.
inventory.visual_appearance: strumming an ornate midnight-wood Aether-Lute glowing with vibrant violet harmonic strings

inventory.name: Silvered Stiletto
inventory.desc: A needle-thin silvered dueling rapier concealed within the neck of the lute or drawn in the off-hand (1d6 piercing, Finesse).
inventory.visual_appearance: holding a gleaming silvered dueling stiletto

inventory.name: Velvet Performer's Doublet
inventory.desc: A flamboyant midnight-velvet skaldic coat lined with concealed mithril chain-links and a silver-threaded scarf (+4 AC, +2 CHA checks).
inventory.visual_appearance: wearing a flamboyant midnight-velvet skaldic coat with silver brocade and a flowing silver-threaded scarf
